in_marathi.name: Priti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Priti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Priti is a Sanskrit word that means love, devotion, or attachment. In Hindu mythology, Priti is also the name of the goddess of love and compassion. She is often depicted as the consort of the god Vishnu and is known for her unwavering devotion and love towards him. In Hindu tradition, Priti is also a virtue that is highly valued and sought after.
